commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Darren England shows a yellow card to Mats Wieffer (Brighton) for a tough tackle.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joel Veltman (Brighton) replaces Diego Gomez.
90+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Darren England shows a yellow card to Federico Chiesa (Liverpool), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
86' Now Brighton have a corner.
85' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) gets a yellow card. The referee Darren England made the right call.
83' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Jack Hinshelwood will be replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
83' Here is a change. Danny Welbeck is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Georginio Rutter (Brighton).
79' Today's referee Darren England rightly decides to book Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) for his harsh tackle.
77' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ibrahima Konate.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Milos Kerkez as he is replaced by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).
76' The referee signals a substitution. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for James Milner.
76' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Yankuba Minteh is replaced by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton).
74' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
70' It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
68' Fabian Hurzeler (Brighton) gets a yellow card, off the field.
68' The foul by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Darren England.
66' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:4.
65' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is about to take a corner kick.
65' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) launches a cross from the corner, but Bart Verbruggen is alert to thwart the effort.

64' What a wasted opportunity by Curtis Jones (Liverpool)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
63' Jeremie Frimpong goes off the pitch and Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) comes on.
62' Diego Gomez (Brighton) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails to the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a quick save to deny him.
61' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Darren England didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

61' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
58' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Brighton players have a reason to celebrate!
57' The Brighton players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
56' 2 - 1 Danny Welbeck (Brighton) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
55' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) offside.
54' Pascal Gross (Brighton) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
54' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' Brighton get a corner.
53' The goalkeeper dives to deny Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
52' Neat passing move from Liverpool in order to create new attacking opportunities.
50' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
49' Brighton exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
48' Darren England rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Danny Welbeck (Brighton).
46' The ball is cleared after Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The whistle blows and Darren England starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Diego Gomez (Brighton) sees a yellow card from Darren England after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

45+4' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Bart Verbruggen inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
45+2' The corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is hurriedly cleared.
45+2' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' A yellow card for a tackle by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool). Darren England doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
43' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool). Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) releases Jeremie Frimpong, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
37' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' PENALTY APPEAL by Brighton, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

32' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) unleashed a long-range shot, but it misses narrowly over the bar. It could have been the goal of the month, at least. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
30' 1 - 1 Goal! Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 1:1.
29' The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
27' Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Darren England ignores the protests.

24' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.
22' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) rises high to meet a cross and steers his header low to the right post. The goalkeeper makes an amazing save. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
22' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
20' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Liverpool control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' 1 - 0 Danny Welbeck (Brighton) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header into the top left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
13' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
11' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Cody Gakpo, but Bart Verbruggen displays great awareness to stop him.

11' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Bart Verbruggen!

10' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
8' Arne Slot is forced to make a change. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Curtis Jones.
7' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
3' The game is interrupted now, Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Liverpool.
3' James Milner (Brighton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a throw-in.
1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Brighton.
1' The first half has started.
Today's kick-off has been delayed due to heavy traffic en route to the stadium.
Darren England is the one to supervise the game today.
